 GREEN BAY (WLUK) -- The playoffs kick off Friday and 43 teams from Northeast Wisconsin have made it to the "second season."
 Below is a quick note on each game featuring a local team, but of course we start with a breakdown of the Game Time Game of the Week:
 GAME TIME GAME OF THE WEEK 
 #5 De Pere (6-3) at #4 Neenah (6-3): A rematch of last year's Level 1 game won by De Pere in overtime. That was classified as an upset, but maybe this time around whichever team wins just records a big playoff win. It will be interesting to see how the teams matchup since these non-conference foes will meet for the fourth time since 2022.
 KEY PLAYERS 
 De Pere: Cayden Cavanaugh (88 tackles), LB. Knowing how Neenah likes to run the ball the Redbirds' top tackler needs to be a factor near the line of scrimmage or it could be a long night. Neenah: Ashton Van Beek, QB. Since returning from a high ankle sprain Van Beek has rushed for 285 yards and passed for 365 yards and totaled eight touchdowns combined in two games.
 KEY TO THE GAME 
 Gaining early momentum. This is the playoffs and a fast start can do wonders for a team's psyche. If De Pere starts fast and can slow down Van Beek this could be a repeat of 2025. If Van Beek and Co. get going, then the Rockets will get pay back.
 DIVISION 1 
 #8 Kimberly (4-5) at #1 West De Pere (9-0): Can Papermakers scare the top overall No. 1 seed?
 #8 Wausau West (5-4) at #1 Bay Port (8-1): Pirates seeking a third straight trip to state. 
 #7 Oshkosh West (3-6) at #2 Arrowhead (8-1): Wildcats take on defending state champs.
 #6 Appleton North (5-4) at #3 Stevens Point (8-1): Lightning taking on Wisconsin Valley champions.
 #5 De Pere (6-3) at #4 Neenah (6-3): A rematch of last year's game won by De Pere 28-27 in OT. 
 *Don't be surprised if: Kimberly makes it tough on West De Pere.
 Neenah hosts De Pere in a Level 1 playoff game Friday. (Doug Ritchay/WLUK) 
 DIVISION 2 
 #8 Germantown (4-5) at #1 Notre Dame (9-0): Can the Warhawks slow down Kingston Allen? 
 #7 Oshkosh North (5-4) at #2 Kaukauna (7-2): North traveling to play old FVA foe Kaukauna. 
 #5 Ashwaubenon (5-4) at #4 Pulaski (7-2): Pulaski won regular season meeting 35-0. 
 #5 Menomonee Falls (4-5) at #4 Menasha (7-2): A win by Menasha would likely mean a trip to Notre Dame for Level 2. 
 *Don't be surprised if: Kingston Allen rushes for more than 300 yards (Allen averages 283 yards per game). 
 DIVISION 3 
 #7 McFarland (4-5) at #2 Winneconne (9-0): Wolves won D4 title last season and riding a 23-game winning streak. 
 #7 Green Bay West (6-3) at #2 Medford (7-2): Wildcats first playoff appearance since 1996.
 #6 Rhinelander (5-4) at #3 Fox Valley Lutheran (7-2): FVL riding a 5-game winning streak. 
 #5 Merrill (6-3) at #4 Luxemburg-Casco (6-3): Spartans have won four of their last five games. 
 *Don't be surprised if: Luxemburg-Casco wins by 14 points or more. 
 DIVISION 4 
 #8 Black River Falls (4-5) at #1 Freedom (9-0): Irish are top overall seed in D4, while BRF was one spot away from missing playoffs. 
 #8 Denmark (5-4) at #1 Little Chute (8-1): Mustangs won regular season meeting 49-0. 
 #7 Seymour (5-4) at #2 Stratford (8-1): Thunder have a tough challenge going to Stratford.
 #7 Ripon (5-4) at #2 Edgewood (7-2): Ripon is the South Central's best defensive team, allowing 14.2 ppg.
 #6 Wrightstown (4-5) at Fuller Collegiate Academy (7-1): Tigers playing a team that played just five games this season and won two, but somehow the record is 7-1 according to the WIAA.
 #6 Xavier (5-4) at #3 Aquinas (8-1): Hawks 5-2 in last seven games.
 #5 Berlin (6-3) at #4 Lakeside Lutheran (6-3): If Berlin wins, it likely plays at Freedom in Level 2.
 *Don't be surprised if: Wrightstown wins by more than 25 points.
 Freedom is a No. 1 seed in Division 4. (Doug Ritchay/WLUK) 
 DIVISION 5 
 #6 Tomahawk (4-5) at #3 Brillion (7-2): Lions have won games by an average scoring margin of 19.8 ppg. 
 #5 Milwaukee Science (5-4) at #4 Kiel (5-4): Kiel enters playoffs 2-3 in its last five games. 
 #5 Peshtigo (5-4) at #4 Chilton (5-4): Peshtigo has not won a playoff game since 2009 (0-8), while Chilton won its last playoff game in 2022. 
 #5 Winnebago Lutheran (5-4) at #4 New Holstein (6-3): Huskies have outscored last two opponents by a combined score of 74-21. 
 *Don't be surprised if: Brillion wins by more than 24 points. 
 DIVISION 6 
 #8 Living Word Lutheran (4-5) at # 1 Manitowoc Lutheran (9-0): Lancers have allowed 24 points this season. 
 #8 Lancaster (4-5) at #1 Bonduel (9-0): Bears have won games by an average scoring margin of 30.4 ppg. 
 #7 Loyal/Greenwood (5-4) at #2 Kewaunee (7-2): Storm riding a six-game winning streak. 
 #7 Fall Creek (5-4): at #2 St. Mary Catholic (7-2): SMC beat Brillion last week to clinch a share of the Eastern Wisconsin. 
 #6 Valders (4-4) at #3 Cedar Grove-Belgium (7-2): Vikings have won four of their last five games.
 #5 St. Mary's Springs (5-4) at #4 Belleville (7-2): Once 2-4 the Ledgers have now won three straight games.
 *Don't be surprised if: Manitowoc Lutheran and Bonduel win by shutout. 
 DIVISION 7 
 #8 Manawa (3-6) at #1 Coleman (7-2): Coleman beat Wolves 51-12 two weeks ago. 
 #7 Osseo-Fairchild (3-6) at #2 Shiocton (8-1): Chiefs have won six games by allowing six points or less (four shutouts). 
 #7 Pecatonica/Argyle (4-5) at #2 Lourdes Academy (8-1): Knights allowing just 7.7 ppg. 
 #6 Abbotsford (4-5) at #3 Hilbert (6-3): Wolves won last two games by a combined score of 59-6. 
 #5 Pacelli (5-4) at #4 Crivitz(6-3): Wolverines win their 1 p.m. game on Saturday and likely earn a rematch with Coleman.
 *Don't be surprised if: Shiocton allows fewer than 10 points.
